26 September, 2022
MCC clarify position on Charlie Dean dismissal at Lord's
Dean was left shattered when India veteran Deepti Sharma decided to run her out at the non-striker's end during her delivery stride, with the dismissal ensuring the
visitors clinched a narrow 16-run triumph in the final match of the series.
Harmanpreet Kaur stands by team-mate following rare dismissal
Much conjecture followed as to whether the dismissal was in fact within the Spirit of Cricket, with the Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC) releasing a statement on
Sunday to clarify their position on the incident.
The dismissal is currently listed in the 'Unfair Play' section of the laws, but is set to be moved to the 'Run Out' section at the start of next month when an update of
the ICC Playing Conditions comes into effect.
ICC makes changes to Playing Conditions
The MCC made reference to the soon to be released update to the playing conditions in their statement and maintained their view that the onus remains on the
batter to stay in the crease until they have seen the bowler release the ball.
